Class BinarySearchTree<T extends Comparable<T>>

java.lang.Object
assignments.datastructures.BinarySearchTree<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of each element, which must have a natural ordering
All Implemented Interfaces:
adt.Tree<T>, Iterable<T>
public class BinarySearchTree<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Object implements adt.Tree<T>

A data structure where data is organized into a mathematical tree structure, comprised of nodes which have at most two children.

The binary search tree satisfies the binary search tree condition: every node has a value greater than that of its less child, and less than or equal to that of its right child.
